chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from his father, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Do not cease reciting Surah Ar-Rahman and performing it, for it does not settle in the hearts of the hypocrites. Its Lord will bring it forth on the Day of Resurrection in the form of a human being, in the most beautiful form and the most pleasant scent, until it takes a stand before Allah in which no one is closer to Allah than it. It will be asked, 'Who was it that used to stand with you in the worldly life, frequently reciting you?' It will say, 'O Lord, so-and-so and so-and-so.' Their faces will turn white. He will say to them, 'Intercede for whomever you wish.' They will intercede until there remains no limit for them, and no one for whom they do not intercede. Then He will say to them, 'Enter Paradise and dwell therein wherever you wish.'

key_terms.سُورَهَ الرَّحْمَنِ: Surah Ar-Rahman (The Merciful), a chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of reciting Surah Ar-Rahman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the unique ontological status of Surah Ar-Rahman, describing it as personified in the form of Adam on the Day of Judgment to testify for its frequent reciters. This narration underscores the Surah's efficacy in purifying the heart from hypocrisy and granting its devotees unlimited intercessory power, allowing them to enter Paradise wherever they choose.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from his father from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

“Recite Surah Rahman regularly and don’t miss its recitation because it does not have place in the heart of a hypocrite. It will be given a beautiful human face on the Day of Judgment and it would be nearest to Allah. It would be asked, ‘Who used to recite you regularly in the world’. It would respond with the names of the concerned persons. Then the faces of those persons would be brightened and they would be told, ‘Do intercession for whomsoever you want’. They would do intercession of innumerable people until there would remain no person whose intercession they wanted to do. Then those people will be ordered, ‘Enter Paradise and stay wherever you like’.”
